prior_execution.note: The first post-merge execution stopped before assay preflight because the frozen direct publisher/NCBI URLs were blocked in GitHub Actions.

trigger: post-merge on main or explicit workflow_dispatch only
source_rule: Acquire exact published SD01/SD02/SD03 XLSX bytes only from the frozen publisher, NCBI PMC, or official Europe PMC supplementaryFiles allowlist. Europe PMC is treated as a PMC International archival source, not a processed mirror. Never substitute a third-party processed mirror after acquisition failure.
source_change_scope: Execution 02 changes acquisition transport authority only. Thresholds, folds, baseline weights, assay normalization, label firewall, and scientific verdict rules are unchanged.
label_firewall: SD01 worksheet cells may not be opened until the persisted assay-preflight receipt is reloaded and its assay_only_sha256 is verified against the persisted assay-only artifact.
raw_xlsx_commit_policy: never commit raw publisher or archival XLSX files
result_mutation_policy: A completed result is immutable evidence for its execution. Any later code, source, threshold, or policy change requires another prospective execution identifier.
